utterances.speaker: HOST
utterances.text: I have been keeping my lecture notes this way for a couple of terms now, and I would not go back to the old way.

utterances.speaker: HOST
utterances.text: The recorder sits on the desk and I only speak into it when something is worth keeping.

utterances.speaker: HOST
utterances.text: Afterwards I read the transcript on the train home and mark the parts I did not understand.

utterances.speaker: HOST
utterances.text: It is not perfect, and it never will be, but it is faster than writing everything by hand.

utterances.speaker: HOST
utterances.text: The part I did not expect was how much it changed the way I listen in class.

utterances.speaker: HOST
utterances.text: I am not trying to write down every word any more, so I can follow the argument instead.

utterances.speaker: HOST
utterances.text: The first few days felt clumsy, and then it stopped feeling like a tool at all.

utterances.speaker: HOST
utterances.text: If you are thinking about trying it, give it a full week before you decide.
